Commentary.Commentary: Bangladesh win and keep themselves in the hunt. A good showing with the ball at the death, along with some fine batting from the middle order puts them in a virtual semi-final when they face Pakistan in a few days. Also, another Afghanistan game, another thrilling contest. It's been a roller coaster ride for them in this tournament, but there's still one more game to go. This team has taken great strides forward in its progress, so they'd like to cap it off with a win. They face India on Tuesday in Dubai at 1530 local (1130 GMT). Do join in for it. Till then, cheers!

Man of the Match, Mahmudullah says that the weather was hot and he was feeling a bit tired while he was batting. Adds that they did well at the end to keep their nerves and eventually win it. Credits Mustafizur for how he finished the last over even after his cramps and calf strain. Reckons that Afghanistan have some good hitters but feels his bowlers did a really good job to win it for them tonight. States that he always feels happy to contribute for his team. Admits that Imrul Kayes and himself had a good partnership in the first innings when Bangladesh were in a spot of bother. Ends by saying that they will need to bring their A game out on the 26th if they are to have any chance of beating Pakistan as they are playing some good cricket.

Bangladesh captain, Mashrafe Mortaza says Mustafizur was like a magician at the end of the match. Continues saying that Shakib Al Hasan bowled really well at the death. States that their main focus was to look for wickets. Credits Mahmudullah and Kayes as they played really well on this slow and sticky pitch which was not the best for batting. On Mustafizur struggling, he says the pacer couldn't run in hard because of a calf strain and bowl the yorkers, so was bowling the cutters and the variations. Mentions that this win will instill confidence and they hope to take it ahead in the tournament.

Afghanistan captain, Asghar Afghan thanks the almighty first. He then congratulates the Bangladesh team and states that they played well. Admits that to make 8 runs off the last 6 balls was not difficult. Feels that Gulbadin Naib was their main batsman who could have taken them across the line in the last over but sadly he failed to do so. Also feels that Mustafizur Rahman is a very good bowler with lots of variations and he bowled really well in the death overs. Mentions that during the middle overs they were progressing well and were on course while executing their plans. Adds further that they had enough wickets at the end and that was the initial plan. Reckons that if their batsmen had taken singles and doubles instead of looking for the big shots in the final over, they would have got over the line. Also says that chasing a total of 250 is not very difficult on this ground and feels they should have got the job done. Ends by saying that they have learnt a lot by playing against full member teams.

Bangladesh were good with the ball for the most part. Started well, were frugal but just lost it a bit towards the end when Nabi decided to take the attack to them, but a phenomenal last over from Mustafizur ensured they got maximum points from this game. Mortaza was good in his second spell when he came back on, the rest were decent, but Mustafizur was sensational. A lot of the credit for the win goes to him. Earlier in the day, Bangladesh got close to 250 on the back of a century stand between Mahmudullah and Kayes, with both of them scoring a fifty each. It eventually proved enough for their opposition.

Chasing a target of 250, Afghanistan didn't get off to the best of starts losing two early wickets. Post that, the Bangla bowlers kept applying the pressure and kept the run flow very much in check. There were two good partnerships in the middle, one between Shahzad and Shahidi and the next between Shahidi and Asghar, but the former went at a slow rate and that hampered things quite a lot. Still, despite that, some big hitting towards the end from Nabi saw his team come close, but it wasn't to be.

Death bowling at its best. The left-armer Rahman shows once again why he's one of the best in the business. Afghanistan came close, but just couldn't get themselves over the line. For the neutral, it made for some excellent viewing. One to remember for a good while.

And that's it! BANGLADESH WIN BY 3 RUNS! What an over from Mustafizur Rahman. Still so young but has so much experience already and he's shown that here tonight. Superb stuff. He angles it across the batsman on a back of a length, Shenwari goes for the big pull. Misses the ball and the bat slips out of his hands as well.

Another leg bye. 4 needed to win now for Afghanistan. If the heat in Abu Dhabi wasn't enough, this game just brought a whole lot more with it. The left-armer lands a length ball on the stumps, Naib moves across his sticks to scoop it over the keeper's head but it goes off his pads towards short fine leg and the batsmen cross over.
Beaten! Length delivery hurled across, Naib swings and misses.

Everyone is appealing for a catch but the umpire signals a leg bye. Interesting. Length ball around leg, the cutter, Shenwari looks to clear short fine leg but apparently misses and the ball lobs towards the same position. Mortaza takes the catch and all appeal, but in vain. A leg bye is taken.
Gulbadin Naib will be the new man in.

OUT! Rashid doesn't last very long! Mustafizur cramps Khan for room seeing him back away. Bangs it short and the batsman looks to swing across the line. Gets it off the top half and it pops back to the bowler who gobbles it up. Still 6 in 4. Still some batting left for Afghanistan. The game, still very much in the balance.
Superbly placed. Length delivery around off, Khan backs away and slaps it past the diving extra cover fielder. That instantly means an extra run and the batsmen take two as the sweeper mops it up.

High full toss on the stumps and Rashid misses out. He slaps it over covers and the batsmen just take the one. Khan wanted the second but his partner refused. 8 off the final over to win for Afghanistan.
Played to the point region by the batsman. Two runs added to the total.
Fuller around leg, Shenwari swings and it goes off the back of the bat past the keeper down the leg side. A single is collected.
Rashid Khan in next.

OUT! Gone next ball! What's going to happen here? Nobody can tell. Can go either way. Nabi takes it on the full and looks to clear wide long off. Doesn't get enough elevation on it and it flies towards Shanto there. He moves to his left and takes a good diving catch. Nabi departs, but he's brought his team in a good position.

SIX! Take a bow, Mohammad Nabi. Doing it for his team and taking it home. Beautiful. Shakib floats it up and Nabi gives the charge. Connects sweetly and sends it sailing deep into the long off stands for a biggie.
Good running. Samiullah works it down in front of mid-wicket and within no time calls for the run. Both batsmen take off and complete the run.
Shakib Al Hasan will bowl the penultimate over.
FOUR! Fine placement from Nabi. Poor line from the Fizz, spills a length delivery on the pads, Nabi works it nicely past short fine leg for a boundary. 19 off 12 now.
Flicked away on the leg side for a couple of runs.
Another appeal, but shut down for the same reason as the previous delivery. It pitched outside leg. It lands and raps Shenwari on the pads. Correct call by the umpire.

Not out! Shenwari survives. Mustafizur bowls the cutter on a fullish length and it raps Samiullah on the pads who for some strange reason gets low to sweep it away. Big appeal and the umpire doesn't bother with it as the batsmen cross over. Bangladesh contemplate and eventually take the DRS. Replays show that the ball pitched outside the line of leg stump. Also, there was a slight glove on it. So a run taken as well.
Review taken. It's for an lbw decision against Samiullah Shenwari. The ball seemingly has pitched outside leg. Over to the TV umpire now.

FOUR! Oh that's poor positioning. Should have been right at the rope. He was too far in and hence missed the catch. Behind and that's an easy catch. Shenwari pulls this short ball on off and sends it flying towards deep mid-wicket. Shanto is the man there and he leaps ahead, only to miss it. It goes over him and falls just inside the rope before going across.
Full delivery at the base of off stump, Nabi slogs it from the inner half through the mid-wicket area for a run.
Low full toss on the pads, flicked through mid-wicket for a single. 11 off the over, a very good over for the Afghans.
Swing and a miss! Takes the pace off this one and bowls it on a back of a length outside off, Nabi swings and misses.
High full toss on middle and leg, Nabi works it in the big gap in the mid-wicket region and takes the first one fast. Rushes back and completes the second. No problem.
Angling in on middle and leg, Shenwari closes the face early and gets a safe leading edge towards covers for a single.

SIX! Mighty blow from Samiullah Shenwari! That's a big hit. Back of a length around off, Shenwari swings his bat with all his might. Connects beautifully well and clears the wide long on boundary with absolute ease. Afghanistan need more, a lot more of these.
Length delivery outside off, Nabi swings and gets an inside edge past the leg stump, towards square leg for a single.
Mashrafe Mortaza to bowl out. Can he make one final breakthrough before he's done for the night?
Moving away from the right-hander, it's cut down to third man for a run. 9 off the over. 42 needed off 24 now.
FOUR! That'll be a boundary! It was wide and short and Nabi just had to go for it. He flayed it over point and sent it across the boundary line. Super shot.
Shenwari makes good connection on that but is unfortunate to find the fielder. Moves inside the line and swipes it across the line to deep square leg for one.
Length delivery going across, outside off, Nabi walks down the track and mistimes the loft towards long off for a single.
Aims the top of the off stick with a length ball, Shenwari wrists this away in front of square leg and crosses over.
Mustafizur is down with a bit of a cramp in his hamstring. Nothing too serious though, from the looks of things he should be fine to continue.
Fuller length delivery angling across, Nabi throws his bat at this and finds point. Still takes off and completes the run without any trouble.
Mustafizur Rahman returns to the attack.

Coming in with the arm again. Shenwari goes for a slog across the line but gets it off the inner half through backward square leg. A couple taken. 6 from the over, that's really good for Bangladesh. 51 needed from 30 balls.
Shenwari leans ahead and plays it with the angle to mid-wicket.
Ball hits the batsman low on the pads.

Not Out! Well, I was completely wrong there. Brilliant use of the DRS from Afghanistan. Coming in with the arm and straightening ever so slightly. Shenwari goes for the reverse sweep but misses to get hit on the front pad. Up go the Bangladesh players in unison and the umpire obliges. Samiullah walks across to his partner and after some discussion, signals for the 'T.' Time for replays. There is nothing on  Snicko. Now, here is the surprise. Hawk Eye rolls in and shows that the ball is going down the leg side. It didn't straighten and kept on going down with the angle. Shenwari will fight on.
Seems like Afghanistan have lost another one. Shenwari has been trapped in front of the stumps but after having a chat with his partner, he opts for the review. Looks dead to the naked eye.

Coming in with the arm, Shenwari pushes at it but gets it off the inner half through square leg and sets off. While coming back for the second, he runs across and almost bumps into his partner but just avoids it. The second run is completed safely.
Good running! Tossed up in line of the stumps, Shenwari makes room and drills it past the extra cover fielder. A couple taken.
Good length ball on middle and leg, worked away wide of mid on for a run. A wicket and 2 from the over. Game on!
A bad shot selection! Shortish ball, angling in, it is too close to cut as Shenwari tries it but fails.
Back of a length ball, punched out off the back foot.
Samiullah Shenwari is the new man in.

OUT! Bowled 'em! Just what the doctor ordered for Bangladesh. Mortaza was a bit off color in his first spell but he has come roaring back to pick up his second wicket. He delivers an off cutter around off. Shahidi shuffles across, crouches and tries to scoop it over short fine leg but has no pace to work with. Gets beaten as the ball kisses his back pad and deflects onto the stumps. This is Mortaza's 250th ODI wicket. Afghanistan need 58 from 39 balls.
The batsman has flicked the ball off his pads. One run added to the total.
Smart deception from Mortaza! He bowls a fast off cutter outside off. Nabi swings at it but misses.
This is sensible cricket from these two! Places this against the spin towards mid on for a run. 10 from the over. 59 needed from 42 balls.
Shakib bowls this one slower in pace outside off, Shahidi has enough time to kneel and reverse sweep it through point for a single.
Shorter in length, Nabi goes for a flashy cut but gets it off the outer half past short third man who chases it and keeps the batsmen down to a single.
Loopy full ball outside off, eased off the front foot to covers.

SIX! Straight as an arrow and clean as a whistle! Slower through the air in line of the stumps, Nabi has his dancing shoes on and tonks it down the ground for a flat maximum. We all know about his big-hitting ability.
Tossed up delivery, knocked down to long off for a run.
Shakib Al Hasan comes back for a bowl.

Length ball outside off, Shahidi plays it with soft hands behind square on the off side, takes a run and will retain the strike. Brilliant over from Mortaza, only 5 from it. Afghanistan need 69 runs from 48 balls.
Very full ball outside off, Mohammad drills it away to sweeper cover for a single.
Wide! Bangladesh need to keep a check on the extras, especially in a tight game like this. Slips this one down the leg side, Nabi tries to play it away but misses.
Shortish in length, angling in with the natural around the wicket angle. Pulled away in front of square leg for a single.
A dot ball! Bangladesh need much more of these to build the pressure on the opposition. On a length outside off, Shahidi taps it with an open bat face towards backward point.
Short ball this time, pulled all along the carpet through square leg for a single.
Full length ball on off, driven nicely towards Mortaza who makes a half-stop and denies the batsmen the single.
Another one in line of the stumps, Nabi whips it through the leg side for a run. Afghanistan need 74 from 54 balls. Very much doable with 6 wickets in hand.
Full and quick on off, clipped away through mid-wicket for a run.

FOUR! Too easy for Shahidi! This is what Afghanistan need to do, hit a boundary in every over and keep rotating the strike. A half-tracker on middle, Shahidi pulls it away past the left side of the backward square leg fielder to find the fence.
Pitches on middle and holds up a bit. Nabi hangs back and tucks it through wide mid on to rotate strike.
Islam gives this one a bit more air, encouraging Nabi to come down the track. He does use his feet but is not quite to the pitch of the ball. Pushes it towards extra cover in the end.
On a flatter trajectory on off, punched off the back foot back to the bowler.
Time for Powerplay 3! Maximum of five fielders are now allowed outside the 30-yard circle till the end of the innings.
Off the mark straightaway. Nabi uses the angle into him and flicks it through square leg for a single.
Back to around the wicket to the left-hander, it's coming back in on leg, Shahidi works it off his pads down on the leg side and gets to the other end.
Mohammad Nabi is the next man in to bat. 83 needed in 62 to win. The game still very much in the balance if this man has something to say about it.

OUT! The Bangladesh skipper strikes! He was struggling in his first spell, but has come back now and got the big wicket of the Afghanistan captain. A cross seam delivery on off, on a length, Afghan looks to go big over the leg side but gets a top edge which balloons towards short third man. Mahmudullah there runs back, settles under the ball and takes a good tumbling catch.
FOUR! Back to over the wicket and Mortaza concedes a boundary. Sprays it on the pads, Afghan swings it and gets it fine enough. Beats short fine leg and finds the boundary with ease.
Angling in from around the wicket, fuller on off, Hashmatullah wrists it towards the mid on area and hares to the other end to complete the run.
Straightaway attacks the stumps and spears it full, Afghan drives it towards mid on and calls for a quick run.
Mashrafe Mortaza brings himself back on.
Low full toss on middle, Asghar flicks it away just wide of mid-wicket for a quick run.
Drifting in from around off, defends it right under his nose.
Swings across the line. Asghar gets low and slog sweeps it over mid-wicket for a double.
Flighted delivery on middle and leg, eased down the ground to long on for a single.
Wide! It's fired down the leg side, wide called by the umpire.

Shahidi is down on the ground with the helmet off. Not sure what the issue is. Is it the hamstring? His back? The physio is out. And both batsmen and the fielders use this chance to get some fluids in. It is really hot out there after all.

Risky stuff from the Afghan pair. Asghar pats it down in front of mid-wicket and both batsmen take off. The fielder charges to the ball but doesn't collect it cleanly as he looks to under arm it. The run is completed with ease but Shahidi seems to have hurt himself.
Spinning in on middle and leg, Shahidi goes back and offers a solid punch to long on for one.
Nazmul Islam back on to bowl.
Full and on off, blocked with the full face back down the track.
Wide! Definitely a wide. The Fizz trying too hard here, banging it in too hard and conceding another extra.
Plays it with an angled bat and guides it to third man. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Good length ball aiming the top of off stump, punched to the man at cover. Dot ball.
Wide! Bangs in short but it's too short, wide called by the umpire.
Wide full toss outside off, Asghar gets a little low and smacks it through towards sweeper cover. One run to the total.
On a good length around off, skidding off the surface, forced to the cover region for a run.
Full ball attacking the stumps, dug back out in the direction of the bowler.
Worked away on the leg side for no run.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Comes down the track to this flighted ball and knocks it to long off for one.
FOUR! Shahidi pounces on the poor length. Comes forward first but then camps back and pulls it through mid-wicket for a boundary.
Tossed right up there, on middle and off, driven down to long on for a single.
Loopy full toss on middle and off, hit past the diving extra cover fielder for a run.
Well fielded. Asghar cuts it hard to point where the fielder makes a diving stop. Afghanistan need 108 to win in 84 balls.
Back of a length delivery, defended from within the crease.

FOUR! The 50-run stand comes up with that! Beautiful shot from Asghar Afghan. He picks up the short length early and rocks back in a jiffy. Pulls it with complete control along the turf through mid-wicket for a boundary.

5th ODI fifty for Hashmatullah Shahidi! Solid knock so far. His 3rd fifty of the tournament, second against the Tigers. Gets to the milestone by pushing it through the covers for a single. Has to stay there till the end now. He's the set batsman for his side.
A loosener outside off, full in length, Shahidi looks to play at it but misses.
Bangs in a bouncer and takes the batsman by surprise, Hashmatullah ducks and evades.

Drinks. Bangladesh will be satisfied with the last hour of play. They lost just the one wicket of their attacking opener, Shahzad but the current pair of Shahidi and his captain have some what steadied their ship. They will now look to take the match deeper and have wickets in hand to launch an attack at the end, if required. Bangladesh, on the other hand, have also done well to not let the Afghan batsmen get away with it. Afghanistan now need 113 runs off 90 balls. We have a fascinating passage of play coming up. Stay tuned...
Asghar works this through the big gap in the mid-wicket region. A couple of runs are taken.
Shahidi places it past the man there on this occasion. Gets a single for doing so.
Punches wide of mid on. No run taken though.
Turns it with the spin through backward square leg and changes ends.
Sliding in on middle and off, Asghar stays behind the line and blocks.
Loopy and on the stumps, drilled down the ground to long on for a single.
Mehidy Hasan is brought back into the attack.

A flatter and fuller ball angling into Afghan, the skipper gets forward and closes his bat face to steer the ball fine into the leg side. It beats the short fine leg fielder again to allow the pair to come back for the second run.

Leg bye! Rahman dishes this fuller length ball on Shahidi's pads, he looks to flick it but misses and the ball brushes his pads and runs down fine on the on side. The batsman have enough time to take a single.
A bit shorter this, and some width offered as well. Shahidi goes for the cut but totally mistimes it and goes straight to backward point. No run there.
Fires this on a good length in line with the stumps, Afghan leans across and flicks it into mid-wicket to take a run.
A good length ball angling into Shahidi, the southpaw waits back and opens the face of his bat to guide it towards third man and crosses over to the other end.
A bit short of a good length ball, angling across the batsman, Afghan defends it off the back foot into covers and pinches a quick single.
Mustafizur Rahman comes into the attack.
Flighted delivery and around off, driven to long on to add a run to the total.
Sees the length a bit shorter this time, rocks back quickly and pulls this towards deep square leg to pick up a brace. He would have liked to deposit that over the ropes though.
A similar delivery and similarly worked to mid-wicket by the Afghanistan captain.
Fires this off spinner in line with the stumps, Afghan works it through mid-wicket but does not find the gap.
Tossed up ball on off, Shahidi leans across and creams his drive to long off to get off strike.
A very full delivery, almost a yorker, is dug out well by Shahidi at the last moment.
Flicked away on the leg side for one more.
Driven towards the mid off region. They pick up a single.
Shortish outside off, punched to the covers for no run.
Driven down to long on for an easy single.
FOUR! A half-tracker from Shakib, Shahidi rocks back and pulls it hard through the vacant square leg area for a boundary.
Dances down the track and drags it off the inner half to long on for a single.

FOUR! Beautiful! Shahidi comes up with one of the shots of the match. Mahmudullah floats this up and keeps it a bit wide of off, Shahidi goes down on one knee and cracks this cover drive right between the fielder at cover inside the ring, and sweeper cover, who tries to run across and cut it off but just doesn't reach it as the ball races across the boundary.
Shahidi flicks this off his pads straight to mid-wicket.
After the 3 dots Shahidi skips down the track, does not reach the pitch and aborts his aggressive shot at the last moment to block this one out.
A straighter delivery and Shahidi flicks it to mid-wicket. Three dots in a row.
Good bowling this by Mahmudullah as he is giving no room to the southpaw, Shahidi punches this but finds the cover fielder.
Very full around off, driven straight to covers.
Shakib fires this into Afghan, the Afghanistan captain tucks this one fine into the leg side and gets a couple of runs for it.
A bit short and seeing this Shahidi rocks back. He looks to whack his pull but mistimes it and gets just a single to deep square leg.
A similar ball is similarly played in the cover-point region.
Shahidi punches this short of a length ball but finds the fielder at covers.
A bit quicker and wide of off, Shahidi hangs his bat out and gets a thick outside edge. The ball runs fine of the fielder at short third man and the batsmen get a brace.
Keeps it slow and on the leg stump line. Shahidi punches it to mid-wicket.
A fuller length ball is driven to mid on. No run there.
Tossed up in line with the stumps, Afghan comes right forward and works it to mid-wicket.
Flighted delivery and full on off, driven nicely to long off for a run.

A run out opportunity missed. Afghan tucks this full ball towards mid-wicket and takes off. The fielder there has quickly got to the ball and has a shy at the non-striker's end. Afghan dives to get in but the ball misses the stumps. Replay shows that the batsman was out of his crease, even after his dive. Needs to be careful.
Pushes this down to long on and gets an easy single.
The batsman defends it from within the crease.
Drives this crisply but straight to covers.
A fuller delivery angling into Afghan, he works this into the mid-wicket region, finds the gap and is able to turn back for the second.
Goes for the sweep and connects well, just a run though as there is a fielder there at the deep square leg boundary.
Afghan again has enough time to rock back and punch it powerfully but straight to the fielder at sweeper cover. They take a run.
This time he does find the gap and the fielder at sweeper cover runs across and keeps them to a brace.
A bit short and Afghan tries to find the gap in the covers with this punch but fails.
Afghan has flicked the ball off his pads. One run added to the total.
The batsman has driven it through mid off.
Similar ball fired in, flicks this to the man at deep mid-wicket for a single.
Fuller and quicker, flicked into the square leg region to take a run and change strike.
A bit shorter this and pushes it into the off side for a single.
Tossed up around off, Afghan watchfully plays it through mid-wicket to take an easy single.
Shahidi gets beaten as he looks to cut it late through third man but misses to connect.
This time the Afghan skipper manages to flick it through square leg to change strike.
Fuller on off, Afghan comes forward and defends solidly.
Bit shorter, punched into covers. Good line and length by the spinner.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Tossed up around off, Shahidi comes forward and leans across a bit and flicks it through the mid-wicket region to pick up a single.
Similar ball and similarly blocked out by Asghar to end a good over for Bangladesh.
Played to mid-wicket region by the skipper.
Asghar Afghan, the skipper, comes out to the middle. Needs to play a captain's innings here.

OUT! Timberrr! Total misjudgement by the attacking right-hander as he goes back after a not-so short ball. It is angled into him in line of the stumps. The ball dips and skids through on landing, goes below his bat as he attempts to cut and crashes into the leg stump. Big blow this for Afghanistan, their hard hitter is gone.
The batsman has punched the ball off the back foot into covers.
Mahmudullah keeps it flat and just outside off, Shahzad goes back quickly and cuts this one to the fielder at point. This one stayed a bit low and the Afghan opener did well to get bat on it.
A bit quicker on the stumps, Shahidi does well to work it across the line, into the mid-wicket region to go to the other end.
Mahmudullah comes into the attack.
Waits back to this and punches it through point to get a single.
Shahidi skips down the track, does not get to the pitch and blocks it into the off side.
Shahzad waits back and punches this one into the cover-point region to get a run.
Fuller ball is driven easily to long on for another single.
The southpaw dances down the track and goes over the cover region. The fielder from mid off runs back and keeps them to two as the timing on it is not very good.
Tossed up and but very full, Shahidi punches this into covers.
Shahidi gets one and keeps strike as he drives this politely through mid on and takes one.
Fuller and slower this one, it's driven through mid-wicket. Good tight bowling this from Bangladesh. Building some pressure.
Shahidi cuts this shorter delivery but finds short third man.
Similar ball and similar result as the bowler stops it and goes back to his run-up.
Tossed up full on the stumps, driven to Mehidy.
Mehidy, the right-handed offie, starts with a flatter ball on middle, Shahzad gives room, opens his bat face and plays it to the cover-point region for a single.
Similar ball, pushed back to Shakib to end the over.
Tossed up on off, driven back to the bowler.
A bit quicker outside off, goes for the cut and misses as the ball skids through.
Tossed up on off, kept out into the off side.
Fiercely cuts this short and wide delivery, the man at sweeper cover does the rest and keeps it to one.
The all-rounder starts from around the wicket and tosses it up in line with the leg stump, Shahidi tucks it away ever so softly through the mid-wicket region to change strike.
Hangs back and keeps it out off the back foot.
Works it fine down the leg side for no run.
FOUR! Fifty for Mohammad Shahzad. His 13th in this format. Also, the 50-run stand is up too. Brings it up in some style. Opens his body up and drills it through the gap in the covers for a boundary.
Shahzad finds the gap through the off side. The cover fielder gives it the chase and keeps the batsmen down to two.
Loopy full toss outside off, forced through the covers for a single.
Loopy on the stumps, driven to the right of the bowler who stops it with a dive.
Mortaza fires this on his pads and Shahidi is in too good a form to miss out on that. He flicks it nonchalantly into square leg to get one.
This time he waits a bit longer and that helps him find the gap towards point and he takes a run.
Shahzad tries to steer it to third man but finds the point fielder, no run there.

FOUR! SMACK! That is typical Shahzad. He gives himself a bit of room, and flat-bats this slower ball on a good length around off. The ball skims through the covers for a cracking boundary. Two in two and Shahzad is finally in the mood.
Defended off the back foot by the batsman.

FOUR! This is the Shahzad we know and have come to watch. He has had enough of touch and run. He takes a step forward and whacks this good length ball on off straight down the ground for a rocketing boundary. The umpire had to duck under it quickly and he does that well.
A fuller and slower delivery around off to end the over, Shahidi drives this through covers to get one and retain strike.
Very full ball attacking the stumps, pushed back to the bowler.
Flatter ball on the stumps, driven gently into covers to change ends.
Goes back to this shortish delivery and punches it towards long off for an easy single.
The attacking opener has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Very full ball around off, Shahidi drives this through covers for a single off the first ball.
Full on the stumps, Shahzad has flicked the ball off his pads.
Shahzad tries to flick this straight ball into the leg side but gets an inside edge onto his pads.
Mortaza fires this into Shahidi, the southpaw tucks it into the square leg region and crosses over.
Shahidi walks down the track and Mortaza, seeing the batsman charge, lands a slower ball a bit shorter on middle, Shahidi mistimes his punch to point.
The off cutter this, lands it on a length just outside off, the southpaw does well to cut it hard but does not find the gap as it goes straight to the fielder at gully.
Mortaza continues after the break with a short of a good length ball angling across the batsman. Hashmatullah blocks it into the off side from his crease.

Drinks break. Clearly Bangladesh's hour. They have picked up two early wickets and really kept things tight. Haven't let Afghanistan score any easy runs at all, bowling a lot of dot balls. If this keeps up, we're going to see action either way. Someone will go for it and score, or get out in the process of trying to do so.
A maiden over from Mehidy. Flights it right up there, it turns into the batsman, Shahzad drives it to the man at mid on.
Five dots in a row. Shahzad cuts it to point and finds the fielder there.
Punched off the back foot by the batsman. Another dot.
Shahzad makes use of his feet to come out and pushes it tamely to mid on.
Flatter and quicker on the stumps, punched away off the back foot towards covers.
Floated up on middle and leg, looks to sweep but it goes off the pads on the leg side.
Hits this past the bowler, down the ground and a single is collected.
Short of a length, takes a step out of the crease to punch it to cover, but Mehidy Hasan there dives to his left quickly and stops the run. Well fielded.
Angles a length ball in on middle and off, Shahzad shapes up for the shot and pushes it back in the bowler's direction.
Full on this occasion, on off stump, blocked tightly once more with a straight bat.
Rock solid in defense, is Shahzad. He hangs a straight bat out to block the length ball. Nicely done.
FOUR! Too wide of off, Shahzad doesn't have any second thoughts about putting this away. Flays this through point for a boundary.
Shortish again, outside off, cut behind point for one run.
Quicker and flatter around off, kept out.
The batsman drives this through the covers. The batsmen have run through for a single.
The off break on off, eased down to mid off for no run.

Around the wicket to Shahidi, it's drifting in on middle, the southpaw flicks it away towards mid-wicket for a single. A stifled shout goes up, as there are two noises, but nothing from the umpire. Good call, replays show that the bat hit the boot.
Spinning in on middle and leg, Mohammad backs away and punches it down to long on for a run.
Width outside off, a good length delivery, cut behind point for a comfortable single.
Hashmatullah pushes it to mid off and takes the man on. Sets off fast and as a result, completes the run with ease.
Angling across on a length, cut on the bounce to the man at point.
Better from the skip. Fullish in length and very close to the off stick, Shahidi looks to play the cover drive but gets an inside edge onto his pads.

FOUR! Mortaza just drops it a bit short and Shahidi pounces on it like a cheetah. He walks down the track, it's a bit wider outside off, so he cuts it over backward point and finds the fence for a boundary.
Back of a length delivery cramping the southpaw for room. He looks to hit it away but can only force it to the man at cover.
Mashrafe Mortaza is back on.
The batsman has driven it straight down the ground.
Flicked away with a wristy shot. One run to the total.
Shahzad opens his body up a bit and drives the tossed up delivery through the covers for a run.
Another dot. Pressure building. It's worked away on the on side but for no run again.
Spinning in on middle and off, played off the inner half on the leg side.
Fullish and outside off, Hashmatullah comes out of his crease and pushes it into the gap at covers to get to the other end.
Turning away from around off, Shahzad backs away to unleash the cut shot but gets beaten past the outside edge.
Turning in from outside off, rising off the surface a bit, Shahidi punches it down to long on and changes ends.
Fast hands from Shahzad. Plays a whippy-cut through to sweeper cover and rotates strike.
Quicker through the air, outside off, cut away to cover-point.
Pitched around the pads, the southpaw manages to get some bat on it as he tickles it fine down the leg side. A single is collected.
Short and going across, Shahidi goes back to cut but chops it off the under edge towards cover.
Short, flat and quick on middle, Shahzad goes back and punches it to short mid-wicket.
The batsman has driven it through mid off. One run added to the total.
Stays around the wicket to Shahidi, bowls it full on middle and off, the batsman can only drill it out to the offie.
Probably was thinking of going big downtown, but decides against it at the last second. Just eases it to long on for a run.
Drives this full delivery through mid off and changes ends with ease.
Starts off from around the wicket and floats it up on off, Shahidi is well forward as he drives it back to the bowler.
Powerplay 2 has been signalled. A maximum of 4 fielders will be allowed outside the 30-yard circle till the end of the 40th over. Also, Mehidy Hasan is into the attack now.
Straighter and flatter, kept out off the back foot. A decent Powerplay 1 for both sides.
Punched down to long on and a single is taken.
Full and straight, driven back down the track with a straight blade.
Throws it across, fuller around off, Shahidi comes forward and pushes it tamely on the off side.
An unnecessary shout for an lbw. Pitched way outside leg. That's the downside of coming around the wicket. It lands and goes on to hit the leg stump probably, but it doesn't matter.
Straighter one on middle and leg, a punchy-drive to mid on results in no run being taken.
Mustafizur comes from around the wicket for the final ball of the over. Angles it in on middle stump, it's worked in front of square leg.
Beaten! Shahzad opens the bat face and plays this late as he tries to run it down to third man. But gets beaten instead as Rahim collects the ball.
Fired full and wide outside off, a cover drive is brought out but straight to the fielder.
Keeps it full and attacks the stumps, Shahzad drives it back down the track. No run taken.
Shaping back in on middle and leg, flicked away on the leg side. Dot ball.
FOUR! Shot. Width offered to free his arms. A length ball outside off, Shahzad flays it over point and beats third man trying to cut it off as well.
Driven to mid on to end the over. A good one for Bangladesh.
Uses the angle to his advantage and flicks it to square leg for a run.
Goes on the back foot this time and keeps it out comfortably.
Turning away after landing on middle, blocked by coming well forward.
Hashmatullah Shahidi to bat next.

OUT! Shah is run out! Much like in the first innings, there's a serious miscommunication from Afghanistan now. But take a bow, Shakib. How good are you? What a throw. Shahzad cuts it towards point and takes off initially. Shah responds and when he's halfway down, Shahzad tells him to go back as Shakib is quick to the ball. He collects and scores a direct hit at the bowler's end. Rahmat tries to get in but he looks short. It's taken upstairs and replays confirm he is. Another wicket for the Tigers and they're on top here.
Direct hit! Looks to be gone. Rahmat Shah is in trouble here from the looks of it. Let's see now...
The quicker one on middle and off, the batsman goes back and punches it hard to mid on.
Turns it away to square leg with the use of the wrists and calls for the single quickly. His partner responds and there's no trouble in finishing the run.
Hits the deck hard as he bowls this on a back of a length on off, it's moving away and the Afghanistan wicket-keeper batsman taps it down after being squared up a bit.
He's finally off the mark. Shah flicks it wide of the mid-wicket fielder and crosses over.
Maintains a tight line, keeps it close to off and on a length, Shah can only defend it out from within the crease.
Seaming away off the deck, rising from a good length, Rahmat makes a watchful leave.
Back of a length delivery on the hips, worked away well but straight to square leg.
Spinning away on middle and off, played back down the track tamely to the bowler.
FOUR! Short and wide outside off, there's room on offer and Shahzad takes full advantage of it. Cracks it well through cover-point and sends it across the boundary line.
Stays right behind the line and keeps it out.

Loud shout, but always going down leg. Varying his pace well though. Bowls the quicker one this time and catches the batsman by surprise. He's hit on the back pad but luckily for him, it's going down leg.
Goes full this time, in line of the stumps, driven to mid on.
The arm ball on middle and leg, kept out off the back foot.
A wicket-maiden for Mustafizur Rahman. Ends the over with a tight line, keeping it on a back of a length. Shah can only play it back down the track.
Firmly hit but straight to the cover fielder. Rahmat Shah drives with the full face but can't find the gap.
Moving away with the natural angle, on a length this time, patted right at the point fielder.
Back of a length outside off, Shah punches it to covers. He takes off and is halfway down the track, but Shahzad sends him back. No harm done though.
Just behind a length and on off, Shah stands his ground and offers a straight blade in response.
Rahmat Shah walks in at no.3.

OUT! The Fizz strikes on the very first ball! Talk about impact. The left-armer slants it across on a good length, it's around off and Janat plays the expansive drive. Can't keep it down though and hands a straightforward catch to Shanto at point. He takes it well with a reverse cup. First breakthrough for Bangladesh, they'll want to capitalize on this now.
Mustafizur Rahman is into the attack.
An entertaining over comes to an end. Islam bowls it a touch short on off, it's blocked.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Short and flat outside off, pushed on the off side again from the back foot this time.
Slightly quicker through the air on off and it spins away, it's pushed on the off side for no run.

Dropped! That was in the air for a looooooonng time. Mohammad Mithun the culprit here. He should have caught that. Shahzad jumps out and looks to go big over long on. Doesn't connect well at all as he's beaten in the flight and skies it towards mid on. Mithun goes a little behind, settles under the ball but can't hold it. Right through his palms and it hits him on his cap. Lucky he didn't get hurt. A brace results and Shahzad survives.
Coming in with the arm, fullish on middle and leg, Shahzad prods forward to defend but gets it off the inside edge towards square leg.
Shorter outside off, mistimes the cut off the inner half to mid-wicket.
Just sits up for the batsman but he can't get it through the gap. Length ball rising off the deck, Janat gets on top of the bounce and punches it on the up to cover-point.
FOUR! Poor line and pays the price. Mortaza darts it on the pads, easy enough for Janat to flick it behind square leg and find the fence as a result.
On the pads, worked on the leg side.
Places it better, wide of the fielder there this time and takes a single.
Back of a length outside off, Shahzad plays it to point. No run taken.
Comes forward to this full ball and defends it back down the track.
FOUR! Better. That's a good shot. Tossed up on middle, Ihsanullah skips down the track and lofts it cleanly over mid on for a boundary.
Make that 4 in a row. Sprays it on the pads and Janat defends it. Needs to keep the scoreboard ticking, can't afford to be put under pressure.
Similar ball, similar shot. Same result. Dot ball.
Too straight in line again, worked away on the leg side for nothing.
Sliding in on leg stump, going further down with the angle, Janat works it down on the leg side beside him.
Nazmul Islam to bowl from the other end with the second new ball.
Good end to the over from the Bangladesh skipper. On a back of a length and around off, blocked safely. 9 from the opening over.
Stays back and keeps it out again.
Better. Length delivery closer to off, Shahzad can only play it out on the off side.
Wide! Down the leg side again, wide called by the umpire.
FOUR! Two in two for Shahzad! It's tailing in on the pads so he just tickles it fine down the leg side. Mortaza needs to get his radar right here.
FOUR! Away in style! A touch short and too straight in line, Shahzad pulls it powerfully through square leg and finds the fence.
Some action straight up. Mortaza bowls a length delivery which angles in on leg, Shahzad is caught on the pads as he looks to put bat on ball. A big appeal goes up but it was always going down leg.

We are back for the Afghanistan run chase. Mohammad Shahzad and Ihsanullah make their presence felt. Mashrafe Mortaza will open the bowling for his team. He is doing so after a couple of games. A slip in place for the skipper. Let's play.
